context: Sho explains his science fair project to Hina.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、科学の実験、しよう。
lines.en: Hina — want to do a science experiment?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant opening. Quiet certainty underneath — he's thought about this. Small boy's voice, warm and genuine. No performance, just an invitation. Slight lift at the end, hopeful.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah — that sounds fun. I'll do my best.
lines.style: Bright, immediate yes. Eight-year-old enthusiasm without shrillness. Genuine delight, not performed. Quick pace on the commitment. Warm and open.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Water changes color — look, it really does.
lines.style: Quiet amazement. Six-year-old wonder, unguarded. Speaks slowly, like watching it happen in real time. Soft breathiness on the realization. No rush to explain, just to share what he sees.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: That's incredible — learning is so fun.
lines.style: Bright recognition. Eight-year-old clarity, delighted to understand something. Quick, sincere. No irony, no performance — just genuine appreciation for the moment and what she's discovering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet tenderness. Six-year-old certainty that this matters. Slow, deliberate — not rushed. The warmth of including her, of wanting to keep going with her. Soft close, like a small promise.
